name: binlist.net BIN/IIN lookup (lookup.binlist.net)
tier_rationale: Long-running free BIN/IIN lookup service (public since 2014) run by an identifiable payments company with public API documentation and an open-data repository (A8 community; P318 provider_tier community).

reliability.justification: Community-maintained IIN ranges: scheme and country are usually right, bank fields are often empty; a missing BIN is not 'unknown BIN' (P318 cond 4).

lookup.title: lookup.binlist.net/<BIN6-8> with header Accept-Version: 3 (scheme, type, brand, prepaid, country, bank)

terms.quote: Free BIN/IIN Lookup Web Service ... Requests are throttled at 5 per hour with a burst allowance of 5. ... Get unlimited access from EUR 0.003 per request + a subscription fee. [home page 2026-11-26; no terms of service or licence page published - P318 cond 2: 'if no business-compatible terms are found, its class becomes unknown and the module stays off']

lookup.notes: Batch p3-G12-1 (P318 card_bin). Only the BIN (6-8 digits) is ever sent. Live 2026-11-26: docs BIN 45717360 -> 200 (0.70 s, Cloudflare); BIN 100000 -> 200 with every field empty (no data); 000000 -> 400 with an empty body. Documented: 404 when no card matches, 429 after 5 requests per hour (burst 5). The binlist/data ranges.csv seed (class unknown, no licence file) and FreeBINChecker (Cloudflare Turnstile) are not part of this build (P318 cond 4).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G12-1 (P318). Terms class 'unknown' until legal records business-compatible terms or a paid plan: the module stays off (default set and corporate profile).
